gate_findings.detail: opex_next_q value 3.8 not visible in Q-3
gate_findings.status: open; dispatched to gen-narrative this round. Not re-dispatched after compute because gen-narrative already showed that no honest narrative repair exists. The only opex guidance in the snapshot is Q-3 'Operating Expenses ~$3.75 Billion' (release_ex99_2.txt). The accurate value 3.75e9 USD is kept. The gate formats USD guidance in billions to one decimal (3.75 -> '3.8'), so it cannot match the quote. Passing would need a number or range the filing does not state, or relabelling the unit as text, and none of these was done. Closing it needs a controller or human decision (false positive, or compare at the quote's own precision).

integration.notes: All five specialists dispatched under the new request_id. Outputs are unchanged from round 1 apart from request_id. The note avoids {{guide_opex_next_q}} and cites Q-3 verbatim.
